Overview.Name: Nuvvula Balraj
Overview.Goal: Reducing diabetes, hypertension and seizure-related health risks, Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Thursday

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Fish curry (120 g) + cooked rice (150 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Egg curry (2–3 eggs) + cooked rice (150 g)
Option 3: Paneer curry (120 g) + cooked rice (150 g)
Meal_2 (Dinner - light): Option 3: Paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid potatoes and limit highly processed foods.
Reduce salt, packaged snacks and fried foods to support blood pressure control.
Take short walks after meals to improve blood sugar management.
Morning sunlight exposure can improve energy, sleep quality and overall health.
Maintain regular meal timings and avoid overeating during social gatherings.
